definitions.short: a Sebaite , or inhabitant of Seba
definitions.full: H5436. Sebaim סְבָאִים noun plural, of a people Seba'im , ᵐ5 οἱ Σαβαειμ , A Σεβωειμ ; — ׳וּס מִדָּה אַנְשֵׁי Isa 45:14 (+ כּוּשׁ , || מִצְֹרַיִם , compare 43:3 above); this perhaps intended also by Ezek 23:42 Qr (see סָבָא ), perhaps confounding it with שְׁבָא , compare ᵑ6 .
